content: Founded from a passion for authentic flavors and great food, Grill began as a simple family dream. Blending traditional recipes with modern grilling, we serve fresh meals prepared with love every day. Grill is not just a restaurant – it’s an experience that brings people together around the table.
content-history: Our slaughterhouse is the heart of the freshness we serve every day at Grill. With high hygiene standards and strict quality control, we ensure fresh and flavorful meat, straight from production to your plate. Every cut is processed with care, preserving its taste, quality, and clean origin. That’s why Grill is more than just a restaurant – it’s a promise of freshness and trust.
